profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Tel Aviv and listed under the ticker WIX. Its own site presents it as a website builder that lets users create a free website, offering more than 2,000 templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain. The company describes the builder as free and easy to use.

According to the site, users can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins, and the company says businesses can keep growing with specialized AI agents. Beyond the ticker, headquarters, and its registration with the SEC under CIK 0001576789, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company.
